title: Black And Dark
description: There is something dark deep within the Overworld. Find it and explore the dark side.
body:
- New 2 ore Tentinar and Detentinar
- Detentinar equipments and shield
- New blocks and flower
- New Darkside dimension and new mob Walker
- New 2 potion effects Shield of light and Dark poison
- Shield of light protects the player from darkness
- Dark Poison deals damage to the player
- New item Book of light using for craft new apple Light apple
- İf player eat a Light apple give Night vision, Strength 2, Regerenation 2 and Shield of light
- Vanilla ores in Darkside dimension
- Worm Hole item for teleport darkside

Sorry about bug and error. Enjoy!
